Container.Name: BookshelfNG
Container.Overview: Legacy BookshelfNG template. Applying its update installs ChaptarrNG and converts a supported BookshelfNG database on startup.
Container.Description: This legacy template is staged to transition BookshelfNG to the standard ChaptarrNG image while keeping the existing /config, /data, /download, host port 8787, PUID, PGID, and TZ settings. Do not apply it while the ChaptarrNG retirement release freeze is active. Back up the complete appdata directory before migration. Public ChaptarrNG 0.9.977 supports BookshelfNG migration-158 SQLite; upgrade BookshelfNG to final 0.4.21.71 first. The older-schema fix is merged to ChaptarrNG main but is not in a public release. Unsupported databases fail closed. New installations should use the ChaptarrNG Community Applications entry. SeerrNG remains optional. Hardcover environment settings are preserved for ChaptarrNG.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: bookshelfng bookshelf readarr hardcover ebook audiobook seerrng
Container.Changes: Transition template: apply the regular ChaptarrNG release to the existing BookshelfNG data directory. Keep an independent appdata backup until conversion and validation finish.
Container.Requires: Docker and persistent appdata. Stop BookshelfNG before applying this update. New installations should use the ChaptarrNG template.
